name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: The official December 1 deadline has no stated entry year; Fall 2027 is not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Published PhD application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated official deadline; confirm the intended entry cycle with the department.

english.note: Department also lists PTE55. English scores valid two years at International Admissions review and sent by testing agency. English exemption requires citizenship AND English-medium education in one of the listed countries, or another listed category. A qualifying transfer from a US college needs a completed degree or at least two years there, GPA2.0 and no more than a three-year break. Recent UB program/degree changes and reciprocal nondegree exchanges have separate criteria. Overseas English-medium study alone is not an automatic exemption. Rare exceptions require a petition from the UB academic department, not the applicant, with justification and supporting records; International Admissions decides.

applicationFee.note: U.S. citizens and current permanent residents may request a waiver through the portal after completing the application and uploading materials.

documents: All undergraduate and graduate transcripts, with English translations where applicable; unofficial copies accepted for review
Passport biographical page for international applicants
requirements.note: Statement covers reasons for UB, academic/research experiences, proposed topics, faculty fit and career plans. Faculty contact is not required before applying; students enter the program and later explore rotations or lab placements. After admission, international visa processing requires a financial form and bank statements, with additional documents depending on funding, visa status or dependents. Recommendation letters: At least two should be from faculty, preferably in the sciences; additional letters may be from supervisors or professional mentors.

funding.note: All admitted PhD students are automatically awarded an assistantship with funding. The opened admissions page does not specify an amount, duration or detailed benefits.

international.note: International applicants are encouraged to apply early for visa processing.
